description: Send native tokens (ETH, AVAX, BNB, POL, PLS, SOL) to an address. Specify the amount in human-readable format (e.g. "0.1" for 0.1 ETH). The amount is converted to wei/lamports automatically. Signs and broadcasts the transaction.

amount.description: Amount to send in human-readable format (e.g. "0.1" for 0.1 ETH)

to.description: Destination address (0x-prefixed for EVM, Base58 for Solana)

name: transfer
